tasks.short: Counsel clients about illness and social difficulties

steps.what: Counsel clients individually or in groups about substance abuse, illness and social difficulties

tasks.design: Keep counselling with the social worker. Existing goals in the care-record system {OTHER} can support the session, but no conversation or therapeutic judgement is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Counselling depends on trust, context and the client's response.
tasks.enabler_now: Documentation tools do not establish a replacement for therapeutic work.
tasks.human_edge: Building trust and responding responsibly to what is said and unsaid.
tasks.altitude: No change to counselling responsibility or contact time.

evidence.claim: The digest documents note assistance, not replacement of counselling; the unchanged design claims no labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is therapeutic contact, not progress-note drafting or assessment. Group and individual sessions are alternative formats.
No structured-input producer or machine consumer is introduced.
Consider native care-record access first; no custom build is justified.
Zero incremental upkeep because the counselling process and tools remain unchanged.
unknowns: Actual individual and group session mix
research_questions: What practical barriers reduce continuity of human counselling?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 after zero upkeep. No invented paperwork share or shortened counselling is counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review client needs and authorised records before treatment coordination
Collaborate with counselors, physicians or nurses to agree coordinated treatment actions

tasks.design: Use authorised care records in {OTHER} for preparation. The social worker and other professionals retain discussion, reconciliation of views and agreement on treatment actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coordination needs professional judgement and negotiation about the client's circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records support preparation but no demonstrated change removes the substantive work.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting recommendations and making sure the client's priorities remain visible.
tasks.human_edge: Explaining social constraints and negotiating a workable plan with the client and team.
tasks.altitude: Decision rights and collaboration remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Electronic records support preparation but no treatment-coordination time saving is established here.

assumptions: Boundary is social-worker preparation and treatment coordination; other professionals' work is outside the focal denominator and unchanged.
No automated treatment plan or structured-input dependency is introduced.
Try native record access before custom integration. Existing runtime earns no saving.
Zero upkeep because no new tool or workflow is proposed. Assessment interviews and progress notes are assigned to their own task boundaries.
unknowns: How treatment decisions are agreed locally
research_questions: Are delays due to unavailable information or to substantive disagreement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 yields net0. No review or professional conversation is removed.

tasks.short: Monitor and record client treatment progress

steps.what: Monitor client progress and capture relevant observations against treatment goals
Evaluate progress, uncertainty and any need for clinical escalation
Draft the client progress record from verified observations and assessment

loop.purpose: Arrange source material into a progress-note draft
loop.output: Draft with attribution, uncertainties and source links
loop.check: Worker checks meaning, negation, attribution and every risk statement against the source and assessment
loop.stop: Any unsupported risk statement or persistent ambiguity returns to manual drafting after one correction
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-text progress descriptions need contextual wording; no diagnosis or evaluation is delegated

steps.what: Correct and approve the exact progress record for the client file

tasks.design: Test native progress templates in the care-record system {OTHER}. A bounded loop drafts from worker-captured observations and the worker's assessment; the worker verifies every claim before writing the approved note to the file.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning observations and professional assessment into a readable record adds wording effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Care-record dictation and note-drafting assistance exists, without establishing automated assessment validity.
tasks.still_hard: Complex mental-health accounts and risk statements can be distorted by summarisation.
tasks.human_edge: Interpreting progress, uncertainty and the need to intervene.
tasks.altitude: Possible modest reduction in wording time; clinical evaluation and client contact stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Attendi turns spoken care notes into structured reports or letters, including in mental healthcare.
The Hengelo pilot found weaker summaries for mental complaints and multiple problems; continued personal notes limited time benefit.
The proposed progress-note time range is unmeasured and does not inherit a vendor percentage.

assumptions: Boundary includes monitoring, evaluation and progress-note production; counselling itself and treatment-coordination discussion are excluded. A roll-up must assign overlapping contact once.

Social worker produces client ID, date, goal reference, attributed observations, client quotations and uncertainty in s1; all45 hours include capture or dictation. The worker produces the assessment in s2, retaining all25 hours. No free transcript or model-generated risk code is assumed.
Missing source detail returns to manual note writing within retained s3 time; full final review remains in s4.
Native templates are tested first. Use only an authorised environment; access and consultation requirements must be confirmed.
unknowns: Whether review outweighs wording benefit on complex cases
Permitted data environment and local consultation requirements
research_questions: Does complete source checking save any net time for mental-health and multiple-problem notes?

approvals.approved_version: Exact corrected progress note and client-record destination; edits or destination changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R92 gives gross8 minus upkeep3 = net5. Low assumes review removes all wording benefit; high needs40% reduction of the20-hour drafting step. Observation, evaluation and final approval remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess clients' mental or physical condition

steps.what: Interview clients and review records or confer with professionals to gather assessment evidence
Evaluate the client's condition using the evidence and professional assessment methods

tasks.design: Keep interviews and assessment with the social worker using source records in {OTHER}. No generated risk rating or inferred diagnosis substitutes for professional evaluation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assessment depends on conflicting accounts, context and professional competence.
tasks.enabler_now: Record access already supports the work; note-drafting capability does not establish assessment validity.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertainty, incomplete accounts and knowing when specialist input is needed.
tasks.human_edge: Asking appropriate follow-up questions and recognising limits of the assessment.
tasks.altitude: Assessment responsibility and time remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: No documented capability in this digest establishes safe automation of individual condition assessment; the design retains professional evaluation.

assumptions: Boundary is gathering and interpreting condition evidence, not counselling, treatment planning or later progress-note production. Interviews, records and professional consultation are case-dependent evidence routes, not three mandatory duplicate stages.
No automated assessment consumes structured scores; capture and evidence interpretation stay fully human.
Try native care-record access first; no custom build is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new assessment system or procedure is introduced.
research_questions: Which uncertainties most often require specialist assessment rather than more document processing?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives net0 after zero upkeep. No interview, source review or professional evaluation is shortened.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Social workers retain therapeutic and assessment responsibility; only bounded note wording is tested for time benefit.
reach: Coordinate specialist referrals and precise source attribution with the care team
role.ambitious_version: A care record that preserves the worker's assessment and client voice, with measured rather than assumed documentation benefits.
